maddeler.e:
تزحلقت (form IIq)
# تَزَحْلَقْتُ (tazaḥlaqtu) /ta.zaħ.laq.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَزَحْلَقَ (tazaḥlaqa)
# تَزَحْلَقْتَ (tazaḥlaqta) /ta.zaħ.laq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَزَحْلَقَ (tazaḥlaqa)
# تَزَحْلَقْتِ (tazaḥlaqti) /ta.zaħ.laq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَزَحْلَقَ (tazaḥlaqa)
# تَزَحْلَقَتْ (tazaḥlaqat) /ta.zaħ.la.qat/: t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
